title: Google’s Gemini 4 Hydrogen Launch: Faster AI Agents for Your Daily Workflow
description:
Google just dropped a faster AI model, but airlines are already locking their doors to autonomous agents. We’re breaking down what this means for your next trip and your daily coding tasks.

What we covered:
• Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen for agentic workflows and broader access
• AP reports lawsuits seeking to freeze new AI model development
• United Airlines blocks AI agents from booking flights

Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways.

Listener question: When an airline blocks your AI agent from booking a flight, do you feel protected or restricted?

What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules.

Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next.
